vokial: Nearly four centuries ago, Vokial ruled his own kingdom. In time, he grew bored with its day-to-day responsibilities and gave everything up for the life of adventuring he preferred. He is an elder even among Vampires.
septienna: Many call Septienna's magic 'wasted' because she seems to draw more life energy from victims than she transfers to her minions. Some claim she retains the residual energy for herself; they suggest this may explain why she does not appear to age.
nimbus: Seth once ruled a kingdom whose name has vanished beneath the sands. Entombed with his household and guard, he spent centuries mastering Necromancy before grave robbers broke the seals of his resting place. The dead king's mummified soldiers still honor their ancient oaths, and he travels between forgotten tombs to gather others into his service. Those who bargain with Seth soon learn that he considers every promise binding, even beyond the grave.
xsi: Only a handful of females were considered worthy of becoming full Liches, and Xsi was among them. She was selected for her unique ability to resist physical damage, a trick that has saved her more than once.
vidomina: Vidomina showed promise as an Alchemist while still young, but her work was not the animation of inanimate matter. She tried instead to restore life to creatures that had once lived. When Bracada discovered this, it drove her from the country.
